remarks: Convenience & sophisticated style is what you get with this luxury 2 bedroom 2.5 bathroom townhouse with finished 3rd floor Loft located in sought after waterfront community with pool. Enjoy the open floor plan, featuring a beautiful eat-in-kitchen with granite countertop, built-in pantry cabinets sitting island, Stainless steel appliances, and gleaming floors throughout. Sun-filled living and dining room with slider that lead out to a large balcony perfect for Grilling/entertaining. Head upstairs to a breathtaking master suite featuring large closets, soaring ceilings and bathroom with double sink vanity, and a stunning walk-in shower. The additional bedroom, updated full bathroom and laundry closet complete the second floor. Fall in love with the third floor loft perfect for home office, 3rd bedroom, or media room. There is a 1 car detached garage along with additional reserved parking spaces, and plenty of visitor parking. Don't miss the pool and spa overlooking the manicured courtyard and harbor! Minutes to Old Greenwich, Stamford train station, and a short water-taxi ride across the marina to restaurants and parks at Harbor Point. Walk down the boardwalk to Prime Steakhouse or The Crabshell for al fresco dining along the marina.
